summary: Iteration 49: Tested PUT /api/expenses/{id} and the Pengeluaran edit UI. 7/7 backend tests passed (basic update, date-month move, kasir 403, invalid id 404, amount<=0 400, loan installment blocked 400 with correct Indonesian message, create+delete regression). Frontend UI test passed end-to-end: create -> edit (form title switches to 'Edit Pengeluaran', amount prefilled, cancel button appears) -> save (row + total updated, form resets to Catat) -> cancel edit flow -> delete. Test data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: update_expense returns the Mongo document directly; _id is renamed to id correctly. Good.

Pengeluaran.jsx uses x.created_at.slice(0,10) for date prefill, which assumes created_at always starts with YYYY-MM-DD. Loan-payment-created expenses go through purchase_created_at style path with same ISO prefix so OK.
startEdit does not scroll form into view on mobile; minor UX nit, not a blocker.
No optimistic rendering; load() reloads whole list after save which is fine for this size.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_iter49 expenses + one TEST_iter49_lender loan (deleted at test teardown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expense edit feature verified. loan_id guard works; expense moved between months when date changes; GET filter respects new month. All data-testids present on Pengeluaran page: expense-edit-{id}, expense-save-button, expense-cancel-edit-button, expense-row-{id}, expense-delete-{id}.
